newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money steady at 3.00/3.05 percent.
newsitem.headline: German call money steady at 3.00/3.05 percent.

text.p: German call money rates were unchanged at 3.00/3.05 percent in quiet dealings on Friday as liquidity remained in adequate supply before the weekend.

Commercial banks' effective deposits at the central bank totalled 38.9 billion marks on Thursday, down from 39.1 billion on Wednesday, while the average for the month through Thursday was at 40.7 billion marks, down from 41.0 billion.
There was negligible Lombard borrowing on Friday.
The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average FIONA= was 3.05083 percent on Friday compared with Thursday's 3.05133 percent. --Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525
